name: Power Monitor
description:
See exactly how much power your laptop is using, live in the top bar.

Power Monitor reads battery wattage straight from the kernel and switches automatically between discharge (on battery) and charge (plugged in), so the number in your panel is always the one that matters.

What you get:
• Live wattage in the panel, refreshed on an interval you choose
• Automatic discharge / charge switching, no clicking required
• Rolling averages since last boot, with a one-click reset
• A power-history chart (15 min, 1 hr, 4 hr) in the detail panel
• Optional automatic screen brightness per power source
• Optional automatic power-profile switching via power-profiles-daemon
• Your call on placement, color mode, icon, and detail-panel size

Built for single-battery laptops running GNOME Shell 50.
